answers.text: Have it return the same three-line shape every time — date, item/quantity, then change. Line one is the date alone, line two is item and quantity together, line three is the change or 'none'.
Ask for one line per claim — date, amount, category, submitter — with a total at the bottom.
The dates in this don't quite line up. The email says the 19th is three days from today, but the call it references was the 14th, five days off.
The 62 versus 54 works out to about 15%, so that bit's fine. But 3 late out of 62 works out closer to 95%, not the 97% it says.
I'd sign off Output 2 — it shows its working. You can't see the sales or returns totals behind Output 1's number.
